advance_semantics: Explicit recorded absolute monotonic update only; equal allowed, backward or wall overflow rejected without mutation
read_semantics: monotonic=recorded state; wall=origin+monotonic; no host elapsed-time input
yield_semantics: No devices. Only deadlines at or before current virtual time supported; returns empty readiness without time progress. Future deadlines fail closed, not a host wait or virtual advance.
security: Existing pipe-only tender and native-tick startup canary unchanged. No descriptor/seccomp changes.
unfulfilled_expectations: Direct clock syscalls remain permitted by existing tender; denial requires separate security-policy review
